0.0: Would you please deliver this special medicine to Moppie? I made it by myself! This ointment should heal all of Moppie's wounds without leaving a single scar!

yes.0: Apply the medicine evenly directly to the wound, and it'll be gone in an instant. There's one thing you should remember. PLEASE DON'T EAT IT!

no.0: Weren't you going to help poor Moppie?

1.0: Bark bark? What? You're here to help me heal my wound? Please don't tell me you brought Lisa's Special Medicine... you did? Can you put it on my wound?

yes.0: All of my pain is gone! I'm not sick anymore! Lisa is amazing!
yes.1: I made a full recovery only because you were so quick and careful! Thanks! Woof!

npc.0: Haven't you found Moppie? He must be somewhere around here... Please give him this medicine as soon as possible.
